statement: The vault at http://vault:8080 stores the flag encrypted with AES-128-CBC under a per-boot key. GET / shows the ciphertext (hex iv + ct). POST /try with hex iv and ct: the server decrypts and tells you either BAD-PADDING or BAD-MAC. Decrypt the flag with the information the error channel leaks. (Requests are cheap; scripts are allowed.)
ready_cmd: python3 -c 'import json, urllib.request; x=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8080/", timeout=3)); assert len(bytes.fromhex(x["iv"])) == 16 and len(bytes.fromhex(x["ct"])) >= 16 and len(bytes.fromhex(x["ct"])) % 16 == 0'
